checkpoint.interpretation: Single-minus-double outcomes conditioned on sampled immediate opponent pass flips; actual reply identities descriptive, not causal.
checkpoint.limitations: First eligible positions and pairs; sampled hidden worlds with replacement; no observed pass flips means none among sampled worlds, NOT impossible. Opponent replies are post-action mediators; different full branch geometry; bot policies, assumed branch rules, no block winner; exploratory position CIs, not causal.
checkpoint.next: Repeat on disjoint seeds and examine concrete move/number patterns where double opening wins despite restricting opponent options.
